name: Remilia
rootCause: The treasury of Remilia, the parent company of Milady, has been drained, with assets from multiple official Remilia wallets being transferred and sold. The hot wallet and multi-signature treasury of Remilia's parent company, Remilia, were hacked, with assets from multiple official Remilia wallets being transferred and sold. Charlotte Fang, the founder of Milady, claimed he was hacked and drained of ETH and NFTs potentially worth several million dollars. Although the project's treasury used a multi-signature model, the private keys were stored in one password manager, which Fang says was compromised. On 2024-03-16, wallets and treasury infrastructure associated with the Remilia NFT collective were compromised on Ethereum. Public disclosures and later treasury redesign documents attributed the incident to centralized storage of multisig signer credentials and likely malware exposure affecting devices used by project leadership. Reported losses included ETH, USDC, Milady NFTs, Remilio NFTs, and NFTX positions with public estimates ranging from direct liquidations to more than $6 million when NFT floor prices were included.
